data.name: Mazhar
data.gender_notes: Mazhar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who brings light and guidance to others, a beacon of hope. The name Mazhar carries the meaning “Light, Illumination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mazhar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual illumination, guiding one towards the right path.
data.etymology: Mazhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Illumination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mazhar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مظهر
in_arabic.meaning: المظهر هو ظهور أو ظهور شيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: المظهر في اللغة العربية يعني ظهور شيء أو ظهوره، وقد يكون ظهورًا صعبًا أو ظهورًا سهلًا، وفي الإسلام يُعتبر المظهر من أهم الأسماء التي يشير إلى ظهور الله أو ظهور رسوله، وهو ما يُذكر في القرآن الكريم مثل قوله تعالى "وَلَقَد رَأَیتُمُ ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ یُشَکْکُ فِیکُمْ فَقُلتُ یَا عِیسَی ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ ارْکَعْ وَاِسمَعْ وَأَنا مُسَلِّمٌ" (آل عمران: 44)، حيث يُعبِر عن ظهور يسوع المسيح، وبهذا النázev يُعتبر المظهر اسمًا مقدسًا في الإسلام، حيث يشير إلى ظهور الله أو ظهور رسوله.

in_urdu.name: مظہر
in_urdu.meaning: مظہر کے معنی ہیں کہ ظاہر ہونا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مظہر نام کا مطلب ہے کہ کسی چیز کا ظاہر ہونا یا ظاہر ہونے کا نام ہے۔ اس نام کا تعلق عربی زبان سے ہے اور اسے اردو زبان میں بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام میں عربی زبان کے مظہر کا لفظ شامل ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کہ کسی چیز کا ظاہر ہونا یا ظاہر ہونے کا نام ہے۔ اس نام کو مسلمانوں میں بہت احترام دیا جاتا ہے اور اسے بھی نیک ناموں میں شمار کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मझर
in_hindi.meaning: मझर का अर्थ है कि किसी चीज़ का खुलासा होना
in_hindi.long_meaning: मझर नाम का अर्थ है कि किसी चीज़ का खुलासा होना या किसी चीज़ का खुलासा होना जैसे कि भगवान या उनके रसूल का खुलासा होना। इस्लामी परंपरा में मझर नाम को बहुत सम्मान दिया जाता है और इसे भी अच्छे नामों में शामिल किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مظهر
in_pashto.meaning: مظهر يوړلوئی د یوړلو د پېغام ليدونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مظهر په پښتو کې يوړلوئی د یوړلو د پېغام ليدونکی په معنا یوړل کیږي. دا نام د عربی او د پښتو ژبو یوړلوئی سره شتله. په اسلام کې د مظهر په نوم د الله یا د رسول صلی الله علیه وسلم په نوم یوړلوئی د پېغام لیدونکی په معنا یوړل کیږي. دا نام د Quran کې د الله ورځنۍ پر دوه وختونو کې یوړلوئی د پېغام لیدونکي په معنا یوړل کیږي.

in_english.name: Mazhar
in_english.meaning: Mazhar means the manifestation or appearance of something
in_english.long_meaning: Mazhar is a name that means the manifestation or appearance of something. In Islam, it refers to the manifestation or appearance of Allah or His Messenger. This concept is mentioned in the Quran, such as the verse "And indeed, you will see the appearances of the Hour and the manifestations of the signs of it" (Quran 45:32). The name Mazhar is considered sacred in Islam and is associated with spiritual growth, enlightenment, and self-realization.

pronunciation.pashto: مظهر په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The name Mazhar holds a significant cultural impact as it originates from the Arabic language, indicative of the Islamic faith. The name is derived from the Arabic word "Mazhar", meaning an outward manifestation, a symbol or an image. In Islamic culture, this name holds deep meaning as it represents someone who is a clear and vivid representation of their faith, embodying the teachings of Islam and spreading its message to others. This name is often given to children to inspire them to be a positive influence in their communities and to bring light and guidance to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mazhar holds great significance as it embodies the ideal of being a conduit for divine guidance and inspiration. The name holds the promise of being a beacon of hope, illuminating the path for others and guiding them towards a deeper connection with the divine. In essence, the name Mazhar signifies one who is a clear and true reflection of the divine light, helping others to find their way back to the source of all creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light, Illumination" symbolizes A person who brings light and guidance to others, a beacon of hope.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mazhar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light, illumination.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mazhar was a famous Sufi saint of the Chishti order, born in 1141 in Lahore, India. The name Mazhar carried significant weight in that era.
